  [Life Sciences]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Life Sciences overview][188]
  **Real-World Data**
  [NLP-Enriched EHR Data Solutions][189] Large-scale, high-quality health data sets.
  **Real-World Evidence**
  [Real-World Evidence][190] Retrospective and prospective research by RWE experts.
  [Real-World Evidence Analytics Platform][191] SaaS application enabling efficient analysis of
  real-world data.
  **Point of Care Marketing**
  [Digital Health Media][192] Highly targeted brand awareness messaging in the EHR.*
* [Health Plans + Payers][193]
  [Health Plan Payers]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Health Plans + Payers overview][194]
  **Gap Closure**
  [Gap Closure Services][195] Proactive, clinically-driven services to help health plans and their
  network providers close care gaps.
  [Care Gap Alerting][196] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Provider Engagement Solutions][197] Streamlined payer-provider collaboration for better gap
  closure.
  **Risk Adjustment**
  [Health Equity Analytics][198] Go beyond Social Determinants of Health (SDoH).
  [Risk Adjustment Analytics][199] Analytics to find and prioritize gaps and opportunities.
  [Risk Mitigator][200] RADV audits - be prepared, not scared.
  [Comprehensive Submissions][201] One cloud-based data management platform for all government
  programs.
  [Utilization Analytics][202] Delivers visibility needed to monitor and manage key performance
  indicators.
  **Data Exchange + Coding**
  [eChart Courier][203] Automated electronic chart retrieval.
  [eChart Coder][204] Boost productivity and reduce costs with Veradigm eChart Coder.
  [eChart Integration and Analytics][205] Automated exchange of clinical data and medical record
  information for analysis.
  **Quality Management**
  [Quality Analytics][206] Proven analytic solution to help plans enhance Quality performance across
  their member base.
  [Risk Adjustment and Quality Management][207] Real-time visibility to monitor and manage your KPIs
  for risk and quality alike.
  **Clearinghouse + EDI**
  [Veradigm Payerpath][208] Claims and risk adjustment solution including an effective collaboration
  delivering streamlined EDI.
* [Healthcare Providers][209]
  [Healthcare Provider]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare Providers overview][210]
  **Our Platform**
  [Veradigm Suite][211] Explore Veradigm’s powerful healthcare solutions designed to streamline
  operations, improve patient care, and boost practice efficiency.
  **Streamline Practice Operations**
  [Practice Management][212] Simplified software for effortless scheduling, billing, and claims
  processing.
  [AI Patient Scheduling][213] Automate and optimize patient scheduling with artificial
  intelligence.
  **Improve Clinical Efficiency**
  [EHR Software][214] Adaptable ambulatory EHR platform that supports your clinical documentation
  and workflow needs.
  [ePrescribe][215] Affordable and certified e-Prescribing solution including controlled substances.
  [Gap Closure Alerting][216] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Clinical Data Registries][217] Registry participation for providers.
  [eChart Courier][218] Save time, reduce costs, and increase efficiency by automating medical chart
  retrieval.
  **Maximize Revenue**
  [Revenue Cycle Services][219] Let us handle billing, minimize denials, enhance coding, and ensure
  timely payments.
  [Coding Services][220] Get help to reduce staff burden and increase revenue - let our team manage
  coding for you.
  [Veradigm Payerpath][221] All-in-one revenue cycle management solution that features a top-tier
  clearinghouse.
  [Veradigm Intelligent Payments][222] Simplify patient billing and boost collections with
  intelligent, automated payments.
  **Engage Patients**
  [Patient Engagement Platform][223] Integrate with a mobile-first patient engagement platform.
  **Optimize Resources and Spend**
  [ERP Fiscal Management][224] Automate finance workflows and improve visibility into spend,
  reporting, and compliance.
  [ERP Point of Use][225] Track supply usage in clinical settings to reduce waste and improve
  accuracy.
  [ERP Supply Chain][226] Streamline purchasing and inventory with real-time visibility from
  requisition to delivery.
* [Health IT Vendors][227]
  [Veradigm Network]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare IT Vendor Solutions overview][228]
  **Powered by the Network**
  [Life Sciences][229] Empowering life science with trusted data and insights from the point of
  care.
  [Health Plans + Payers][230] Connecting payers to the Veradigm Network’s comprehensive, national
  provider footprint.
  [Providers][231] Integrated clinical & financial solutions for a healthier practice.
  **API Connectivity**
  [Veradigm Connect][232] Connect the latest health tech solutions with the physicians and patients
  who need them.
  [App Expo][233] Become one of hundreds of certified applications and devices for provider
  practices built on open APIs.
  [Diagnostic Ordering and Results Network (DORN)][234] Connecting EHR Vendors with Lab and
  Radiology centers.
  **Electronic Prescribing**
  [Veradigm ePrescribe Enterprise][235] Integrated, advanced, easy-to-use ePrescribing for EHR and
  HIT vendors.
* [Insights][236]
  [Two hands typing on a laptop]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Filter through all of Veradigm's Insights][237]
  **Veradigm Insights**
  [Blog Posts][238] Read through our collection of valuable insights.
  [Videos][239] Watch our videos to learn more about our offerings.
  [Thought Leadership][240] Read the latest healthcare insights from our team of subject matter
  experts.
  [Podcasts][241] Listen to our podcasts to hear healthcare insights from our team of experts.
  [Webinars][242] Watch our webinars to learn more about how we are transforming health,
  insightfully.
  **Resources**
  [RWE Publications][243] Read through our RWE publications and learn how we help clients.
  [Clinical Data Registries][244] Explore our registry publications and learn how we help clients.
  [*Smart Medicine* Podcast][245] Thought-provoking podcast dedicated to understanding the
  intersection of care and innovation
  **Trending Topics**
  [Value-Based Care][246] Comprehensive guide to value-based care, including use cases, relevant
  blog articles, white papers and more.
  [Real-World Evidence][247] Complete overview of real-world evidence, why it’s important, and how
  it’s used in healthcare.
  [Real-World Data][248] Thorough review of what real-world healthcare data is, how it’s collected,
  and how it’s used across the healthcare spectrum.
  [Payer Provider Relationships Guide][249] Discover the impact of payer-provider relationships on
  healthcare. Learn how collaboration improves patient care and addresses challenges.

  programs.

  indicators.

  [eChart Courier][203] Automated electronic chart retrieval.

  [eChart Integration and Analytics][205] Automated exchange of clinical data and medical record
  information for analysis.

  [Quality Analytics][206] Proven analytic solution to help plans enhance Quality performance across
  their member base.

  for risk and quality alike.

  [Veradigm Payerpath][208] Claims and risk adjustment solution including an effective collaboration
  delivering streamlined EDI.

  [Veradigm Suite][211] Explore Veradigm’s powerful healthcare solutions designed to streamline
  operations, improve patient care, and boost practice efficiency.

  [Practice Management][212] Simplified software for effortless scheduling, billing, and claims
  processing.
  [AI Patient Scheduling][213] Automate and optimize patient scheduling with artificial
  intelligence.
  **Improve Clinical Efficiency**
  [EHR Software][214] Adaptable ambulatory EHR platform that supports your clinical documentation
  and workflow needs.
  [ePrescribe][215] Affordable and certified e-Prescribing solution including controlled substances.
  [Gap Closure Alerting][216] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Clinical Data Registries][217] Registry participation for providers.
  [eChart Courier][218] Save time, reduce costs, and increase efficiency by automating medical chart
  retrieval.

  [Revenue Cycle Services][219] Let us handle billing, minimize denials, enhance coding, and ensure
  timely payments.
  [Coding Services][220] Get help to reduce staff burden and increase revenue - let our team manage
  coding for you.
  [Veradigm Payerpath][221] All-in-one revenue cycle management solution that features a top-tier
  clearinghouse.
  [Veradigm Intelligent Payments][222] Simplify patient billing and boost collections with
  intelligent, automated payments.
  **Engage Patients**
  [Patient Engagement Platform][223] Integrate with a mobile-first patient engagement platform.
  **Optimize Resources and Spend**
  [ERP Fiscal Management][224] Automate finance workflows and improve visibility into spend,
  reporting, and compliance.
  [ERP Point of Use][225] Track supply usage in clinical settings to reduce waste and improve
  accuracy.
  [ERP Supply Chain][226] Streamline purchasing and inventory with real-time visibility from
  requisition to delivery.

    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

Engineering the

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further

We prevent diseases by identifying high-risk patients early to enable timely use of medicines.

Our strategy

curative medicines.

## **Global Employee Benefit Programs**

Best in class global and local employee benefit programs for multinational corporations 

### **[Multinational
### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

### **[ Global
### Pension][116]**
###  
###  
###  

A central coordination of local solutions that helps multinational companies to increase governance
and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

## **What is global coverage health insurance?**

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,
emergency evacuation, diagnostic tests and more.

## **How much does global health insurance cost?**

The cost of global health insurance varies based on factors such as number of members included in
the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for
individual and small groups). Please [get in touch][132] with our sales team for a detailed quote.

### **[Multinational
### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###

in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

## **What is global coverage health insurance?**

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,
emergency evacuation, diagnostic tests and more.

the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for

## See how we’ve reimagined Authorize.net

### New features, built for speed

Get paid faster with customizable dashboards, smart AI support, and built-in fraud prevention—all
powered by Visa’s payments ecosystem.

### Take, request, and find payments

Get set up fast with a seamless, intuitive payment experience.

### Tools to stop fraud fast

Protect every payment with built-in, real-time fraud detection.

[Demo for businesses][36]

[Demo for partners][37]

## Make payments a growth engine for your business

#### Online payments

Offer flexible online payments with credit cards, debit cards, eChecks, and major digital wallets
like Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal for secure, convenient checkout.

[ [Learn more about online payments] ][38]

#### Smartphone payments

Accept secure mobile payments with smartphones, supporting QR codes, digital wallets, and fast
tap‑to‑pay options for easy checkout.

[ [Learn more about mobile payments] ][39]

Use Virtual Point of Sale to connect a card reader to your computer, sign in, and accept reliable
in‑person payments quickly and securely.

[ [Learn more about Virtual Point of Sale] ][40]

Process phone orders securely by entering customer details in the Virtual Terminal, allowing quick
manual payments through any web browser.

Enable simple eCheck payments for recurring billing, invoices, and contactless transactions,
offering a low‑cost, dependable digital alternative.

Add Buy Now or Donate buttons to your site for fast checkout, ideal for nonprofits and merchants

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]


[Patient pictured kneeling next to her Golden Retriever]
[Patient Story][53]

### From Pump to Pup: Finding Comfort in 'Baxter'

Izzy, a young cancer fighter and survivor, loves her dog, Baxter, named after the brand she saw on
the infusion pumps that delivered her chemotherapy.

[Read More][54]
[nurse smiling and standing next to a window ]
[Healthcare Insights][55]

### Technology and Service Support Chronic Disease Management at Home

Conditions such as hypertension, respiratory illnesses and cardiac issues can be monitored
effectively with innovative tools and connected devices.

[Read More][56]
[group event at a baseball game]
[People of Baxter][57]

### The Power of Teamwork to Support Patient Care

Teams bridged the pandemic and borders to bring an innovative ICU bed to life.

[Read More][58]
[Collage of images showing innovations in a manufacturing setting]
[Healthcare Insights][59]

### Supply Chain Innovation Delivers More Nimble, Efficient Solutions

Leaders from Baxter speak about our evolutions in manufacturing and supply chain processes as we
emerge from the COVID-19 pandemic

[Read More][60]
[Kim sitting at her desk smiling]
[People of Baxter][61]

### A Teacher at Heart

After losing her parents to heart disease, Kim resolved to share her knowledge about cardiac
monitoring with HCPs to identify potential issues early.

[Read More][62]
[Chabot graphic]
[Healthcare Insights][63]

### Dr. Chatbot Will See You Now

What role will AI play in healthcare in the future? We believe there are realistic opportunities for
AI to make healthcare more efficient and effective

[Read More][64]
[ Press Release ][65]

### Baxter Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report Highlighting Refreshed Strategy, Ongoing Commitment
### to Drive Meaningful Impact

[Read More][66]
[ Press Release ][67]

### Baxter Reports First-Quarter 2026 Results

[Read More][68]
[ Press Release ][69]

### Baxter Showcases Recent Innovations at AORN Global Surgical Conference and Expo 2026

[Read More][70]

## Our Commitment to Healthcare Professionals and Patients

We are committed to supporting patients and healthcare professionals with innovations that are
driven by compassion for their journeys, a passion to improve care and the ambition to transform the
future of healthcare.

[A doctor in a hospital room looks off to the side]

## Products for Healthcare Professionals

### Primary Care [ Primary Care Go to Primary Care ][71]

Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
vitals monitoring and vision screening

[ Go to Primary Care ][72]

### Hospital Care [ Hospital Care Go to Hospital Care ][73]

Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
workflows

[ Go to Hospital Care ][74]

### Surgical Care [ Surgical Care Go to Surgical Care ][75]

Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
outcomes

[ Go to Surgical Care ][76]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][77]

Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and at
home

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][78]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][79]

Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve mobility

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][80]

### Our Products [ Our Products Go to Our Products ][81]

Enabling clinicians to treat patients more efficiently and effectively across care settings,
including in the office-based practice, inpatient care, outpatient care and at home

[ Go to Our Products ][82]
[Two ladies have a discussion in a coffee shop]

## For Patients

You are our passion. Your stories inspire us to work harder at bringing innovations that can make
your experience easier, speed recovery and enable the best possible quality of life.

[Discover Patient Stories][83]

### More For Patients

### General Healthcare [ General Healthcare Go to General Healthcare ][84]

Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
support every step of your journey.

[ Go to General Healthcare ][85]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][86]

When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide clinical nutrition
options to help you regain your nutritional status.

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][87]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][88]

We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven respiratory
therapy in the hospital and at home.

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][89]

## Bringing our Purpose to Life

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to
be an agent of change at a global level. This means doing what is right for our planet, our patients
and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

### Our Leadership

Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet our commitments – every
day and everywhere.

[Learn More About Our Leadership][90]

### Our Corporate Responsibility

For nearly a century, we have made a meaningful difference in global healthcare while creating
lasting value for the communities we serve.

[Learn More About Our Corporate Responsibility][91]

### Careers

This is where an inclusive community of diverse individuals is driven to go beyond what is, to what
is possible in healthcare.

[Learn More About Careers at Baxter][92]

### Our History

For more than 90 years, we’ve been focused on our commitment to save and sustain lives with
innovations that elevate patient care, improve outcomes and drive healthcare transformation.

[Learn More About Our History][93]

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

# Microbiome. Manufacturing. Mastered.

From strains to finished products, Biose Industrie manufactures microbiome solutions for
pharmaceutical and non-pharmaceutical markets, supporting projects from development to commercial
supply.

##### Biose

## BIOSE INDUSTRIE

Biose Industrie is a specialised microbiome CDMO supporting biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and
consumer-focused companies across Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs), Next-Generation Probiotics
(NGPs), consumer health, consumer care, and cosmetics.

We combine deep aerobic and anaerobic microbiology expertise, industrial scale, and robust GMP
quality systems to take projects from development to commercialisation.

##### Vision

## Vision

Our vision is to build a future where the potential of micro-organisms strengthens and enhances
health and well-being, across regulated pharmaceutical applications and everyday consumer solutions.

##### Identity

## Identity

A pioneer in pharmaceutical microbiology since 1951, Biose Industrie operates two complementary
businesses serving a wide range of industries:

### CDMO Services

An international CDMO specialised in Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs) and Next-Generation
Probiotics (NGPs), from process development to GMP drug product manufacturing.

### Strains, Ingredients & Finished Products

Supplier of microbiome-based ingredients and finished products under private label for the health,
nutrition, wellness, and cosmetic markets.

##### Mission

## Mission

Our mission is to contribute to the success and satisfaction of our clients by delivering
micro-organism-based solutions — ingredients, finished products, and dedicated developments — driven
by scientific excellence, industrial performance, and anticipation of regulatory and market
evolutions.

# Home Biose

# Your microbiome partner

# Microbiome. Manufacturing. Mastered.

From strains to finished products, Biose Industrie manufactures microbiome solutions for
pharmaceutical and non-pharmaceutical markets, supporting projects from development to commercial
supply.

##### Biose

## BIOSE INDUSTRIE

Biose Industrie is a specialised microbiome CDMO supporting biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and
consumer-focused companies across Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs), Next-Generation Probiotics
(NGPs), consumer health, consumer care, and cosmetics.

We combine deep aerobic and anaerobic microbiology expertise, industrial scale, and robust GMP
quality systems to take projects from development to commercialisation.

##### Vision

## Vision

Our vision is to build a future where the potential of micro-organisms strengthens and enhances
health and well-being, across regulated pharmaceutical applications and everyday consumer solutions.

##### Identity

## Identity

A pioneer in pharmaceutical microbiology since 1951, Biose Industrie operates two complementary
businesses serving a wide range of industries:

### CDMO Services

An international CDMO specialised in Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs) and Next-Generation
Probiotics (NGPs), from process development to GMP drug product manufacturing.

### Strains, Ingredients & Finished Products

Supplier of microbiome-based ingredients and finished products under private label for the health,
nutrition, wellness, and cosmetic markets.

##### Mission

## Mission

Our mission is to contribute to the success and satisfaction of our clients by delivering
micro-organism-based solutions — ingredients, finished products, and dedicated developments — driven
by scientific excellence, industrial performance, and anticipation of regulatory and market
evolutions.

## Frequently Asked Questions
* ### What is Butterfly iQ+ and Butterfly iQ3?
  
  Butterfly iQ+ and iQ3 are FDA-cleared handheld ultrasound devices that connect to a compatible
  iPhone or Android smartphone or tablet. Both use Butterfly's Ultrasound-on-Chip™ semiconductor
  technology, which replaces the multiple piezoelectric probes required by traditional ultrasound
  systems with a single handheld probe capable of whole-body imaging. iQ3 offers improved image
  quality and extended battery life compared to iQ+.
  
  ### What is handheld ultrasound?
  
  Handheld ultrasound is a portable imaging solution that allows clinicians to perform ultrasound
  exams at the point of care — at the bedside, in the clinic, or in the field — using a compact,
  pocket-sized device. Unlike traditional cart-based ultrasound systems, handheld devices like the
  Butterfly iQ3 connect directly to a compatible smartphone or tablet, eliminating the need for
  dedicated hardware and enabling faster, more flexible clinical workflows.
  
  ### Why is Butterfly different from traditional ultrasound systems?
  
  Butterfly replaces traditional ultrasound — both cart-based systems and handheld piezoelectric
  devices — with a single semiconductor-based probe built on Ultrasound-on-Chip™ technology.
  Traditional systems require multiple probes, costly hardware maintenance, and dedicated carts.
  Butterfly's single probe performs multiple imaging modes across the whole body with software that
  improves over time, and is priced much lower than what conventional system costs.
  
  ### Does Butterfly use AI in ultrasound?
  
  Yes. Butterfly integrates AI across image capture, clinical workflows, and enterprise management.
  On-device AI tools assist with image guidance, anatomy identification, and real-time feedback.
  Butterfly's CompassAI™ enterprise software automates documentation, quality assurance, and billing
  workflows for point-of-care ultrasound programs.
  
  ### Who uses Butterfly ultrasound?
  
  Butterfly ultrasound is used by a wide range of healthcare professionals including emergency
  physicians, hospitalists, intensivists, cardiologists, anesthesiologists, primary care providers,
  nurses, paramedics, military medics, and medical students. Butterfly devices are deployed in
  emergency departments, ICUs, operating rooms, outpatient clinics, primary care practices, and
  remote or resource-limited settings.
  
  ### Is AI-assisted ultrasound accurate?
  
  AI-assisted ultrasound tools, including those in Butterfly devices, are designed to improve
  consistency in image acquisition and support clinical workflows — not to replace clinical
  judgment. Butterfly's AI guidance helps clinicians acquire better images faster, which can improve
  the reliability of findings. As with all diagnostic tools, trained clinical interpretation remains
  essential.
  
  ### How much does a Butterfly device cost?
  
  Butterfly iQ+ starts at $2,699 for the handheld probe. Pricing varies based on model, software
  membership tier, and whether the purchase is for individual or enterprise use. Enterprise pricing
  includes additional workflow tools, analytics, and volume options. A Butterfly membership
  subscription is required and unlocks cloud storage, AI-powered features, and ongoing software
  updates.
  
  ### Is a subscription required to use Butterfly?
  
  Yes. A Butterfly membership is required and is designed to expand the device's capabilities over
  time. Membership tiers provide access to cloud storage, workflow tools, and AI-powered features.
  Because Butterfly is a software-driven platform, new capabilities are delivered through software
  updates to the same hardware — meaning the device improves with the membership.
  
  ### What support and training are included with Butterfly?
  
  Butterfly provides onboarding services, in-app guidance, and access to ScanLab™ — an AI-guided,
  simulation-based training application — along with on-demand learning modules and live training
  sessions. Enterprise customers receive additional implementation support, quality assurance tools
  via CompassAI, and dedicated customer success resources. All active memberships include software
  updates and customer support.
  
  ### What is the ROI of handheld ultrasound?
  
  Butterfly Network’s handheld ultrasound delivers ROI through low upfront hardware cost, fast
  clinical decision-making, and reduced reliance on external imaging referrals. A key driver for
  enterprise customers is Butterfly's CompassAI workflow software, which captures documentation in
  real time and reduces unrecorded or 'ghost' scans. By improving billing compliance and capturing
  revenue from scans that would otherwise go undocumented, CompassAI can help health systems realize
  measurable financial returns.
  
  ### Does Butterfly iQ3 work with iPhone and Android?
  
  Yes. Both Butterfly iQ3 and iQ+ are compatible with a range of iPhone and Android smartphones and
  tablets. Clinicians use the Butterfly iQ mobile app to display, capture, and manage ultrasound
  imaging directly on their device. Compatibility details for specific models are available
  [here][66].
  
  ### Do you need internet to use Butterfly ultrasound?
  
  After the app has been downloaded onto a mobile device, the account has been created and the user
  has logged in, the Butterfly probe can be used without the internet.
  
  Please note that Butterfly iQ app must connect to the internet every 30 days. If your device does
  not connect to the internet for 30 days or more, you will be unable to scan until connected to the
  internet.
  
  ### How do I purchase a Butterfly device or request a demo?
  
  Butterfly devices can be purchased directly at butterflynetwork.com by clicking 'Store' in the top
  navigation. To speak with a sales representative or see a live demonstration, click 'Get Demo' in
  the navigation bar and complete the request form.

## Frequently Asked Questions
* ### What is Butterfly iQ+ and Butterfly iQ3?
  
  Butterfly iQ+ and iQ3 are FDA-cleared handheld ultrasound devices that connect to a compatible
  iPhone or Android smartphone or tablet. Both use Butterfly's Ultrasound-on-Chip™ semiconductor
  technology, which replaces the multiple piezoelectric probes required by traditional ultrasound
  systems with a single handheld probe capable of whole-body imaging. iQ3 offers improved image
  quality and extended battery life compared to iQ+.
  
  ### What is handheld ultrasound?
  
  Handheld ultrasound is a portable imaging solution that allows clinicians to perform ultrasound
  exams at the point of care — at the bedside, in the clinic, or in the field — using a compact,
  pocket-sized device. Unlike traditional cart-based ultrasound systems, handheld devices like the
  Butterfly iQ3 connect directly to a compatible smartphone or tablet, eliminating the need for
  dedicated hardware and enabling faster, more flexible clinical workflows.
  
  ### Why is Butterfly different from traditional ultrasound systems?
  
  Butterfly replaces traditional ultrasound — both cart-based systems and handheld piezoelectric
  devices — with a single semiconductor-based probe built on Ultrasound-on-Chip™ technology.
  Traditional systems require multiple probes, costly hardware maintenance, and dedicated carts.
  Butterfly's single probe performs multiple imaging modes across the whole body with software that
  improves over time, and is priced much lower than what conventional system costs.
  
  ### Does Butterfly use AI in ultrasound?
  
  Yes. Butterfly integrates AI across image capture, clinical workflows, and enterprise management.
  On-device AI tools assist with image guidance, anatomy identification, and real-time feedback.
  Butterfly's CompassAI™ enterprise software automates documentation, quality assurance, and billing
  workflows for point-of-care ultrasound programs.
  
  ### Who uses Butterfly ultrasound?
  
  Butterfly ultrasound is used by a wide range of healthcare professionals including emergency
  physicians, hospitalists, intensivists, cardiologists, anesthesiologists, primary care providers,
  nurses, paramedics, military medics, and medical students. Butterfly devices are deployed in
  emergency departments, ICUs, operating rooms, outpatient clinics, primary care practices, and
  remote or resource-limited settings.
  
  ### Is AI-assisted ultrasound accurate?
  
  AI-assisted ultrasound tools, including those in Butterfly devices, are designed to improve
  consistency in image acquisition and support clinical workflows — not to replace clinical
  judgment. Butterfly's AI guidance helps clinicians acquire better images faster, which can improve
  the reliability of findings. As with all diagnostic tools, trained clinical interpretation remains
  essential.
  
  ### How much does a Butterfly device cost?
  
  Butterfly iQ+ starts at $2,699 for the handheld probe. Pricing varies based on model, software
  membership tier, and whether the purchase is for individual or enterprise use. Enterprise pricing
  includes additional workflow tools, analytics, and volume options. A Butterfly membership
  subscription is required and unlocks cloud storage, AI-powered features, and ongoing software
  updates.
  
  ### Is a subscription required to use Butterfly?
  
  Yes. A Butterfly membership is required and is designed to expand the device's capabilities over
  time. Membership tiers provide access to cloud storage, workflow tools, and AI-powered features.
  Because Butterfly is a software-driven platform, new capabilities are delivered through software
  updates to the same hardware — meaning the device improves with the membership.
  
  ### What support and training are included with Butterfly?
  
  Butterfly provides onboarding services, in-app guidance, and access to ScanLab™ — an AI-guided,
  simulation-based training application — along with on-demand learning modules and live training
  sessions. Enterprise customers receive additional implementation support, quality assurance tools
  via CompassAI, and dedicated customer success resources. All active memberships include software
  updates and customer support.
  
  ### What is the ROI of handheld ultrasound?
  
  Butterfly Network’s handheld ultrasound delivers ROI through low upfront hardware cost, fast
  clinical decision-making, and reduced reliance on external imaging referrals. A key driver for
  enterprise customers is Butterfly's CompassAI workflow software, which captures documentation in
  real time and reduces unrecorded or 'ghost' scans. By improving billing compliance and capturing
  revenue from scans that would otherwise go undocumented, CompassAI can help health systems realize
  measurable financial returns.
  
  ### Does Butterfly iQ3 work with iPhone and Android?
  
  Yes. Both Butterfly iQ3 and iQ+ are compatible with a range of iPhone and Android smartphones and
  tablets. Clinicians use the Butterfly iQ mobile app to display, capture, and manage ultrasound
  imaging directly on their device. Compatibility details for specific models are available
  [here][66].
  
  ### Do you need internet to use Butterfly ultrasound?
  
  After the app has been downloaded onto a mobile device, the account has been created and the user
  has logged in, the Butterfly probe can be used without the internet.
  
  Please note that Butterfly iQ app must connect to the internet every 30 days. If your device does
  not connect to the internet for 30 days or more, you will be unable to scan until connected to the
  internet.

  navigation. To speak with a sales representative or see a live demonstration, click 'Get Demo' in
  the navigation bar and complete the request form.

As health systems turn to virtual care models to address staffing shortages, eCareManager helps by
enabling inpatient care teams to seamlessly connect with remote clinicians. Timely insights,
customizable alerts and data-driven benchmarks with a goal of helping ensure the quality and
efficiency of patient care delivery.

Clinical Insights Manager is a service-oriented, end-to-end solution that allows hospitals to
synthesize high-fidelity clinical data. It combines storage and aggregation of data with tools that
allow you to query, filter and sort it so you can transform this information into valuable insights
that help you achieve your clinical healthcare goals.

continuous analysis of live, streaming medical data. Clinical surveillance facilitates proactive
care by sending precise notifications to the healthcare team.

centralizes, streamlines and provides simplified visual data to deliver structured documentation and

## Medical Device Integration

Unlock the value of your medical devices with a vendor neutral platform that enables secure capture
of virtually all live-streaming data – measurements, settings, alarms and waveforms – from over
1,200 different medical devices. Data can be delivered using industry standard protocols to over 100
different systems, including electronic health records (EHRs), clinical information systems,
decision support, alarm management, research and reporting.

[card-virtual-care]

## Virtual Care

As health systems turn to virtual care models to address staffing shortages, eCareManager helps by
enabling inpatient care teams to seamlessly connect with remote clinicians. Timely insights,
customizable alerts and data-driven benchmarks with a goal of helping ensure the quality and
efficiency of patient care delivery.

### Explore our solutions:

[eCareManager][95]

[ Request a demo ][96]
[card-retrospective-analytics]

## Retrospective Analytics

Clinical Insights Manager is a service-oriented, end-to-end solution that allows hospitals to
synthesize high-fidelity clinical data. It combines storage and aggregation of data with tools that
allow you to query, filter and sort it so you can transform this information into valuable insights
that help you achieve your clinical healthcare goals.

### Explore our solution:

[Clinical Insights Manager][97]

[ Request a demo ][98]
[card-surveillance]

## Surveillance

Capsule Surveillance helps simplify complex workflows and makes patient monitoring insightful by
continuous analysis of live, streaming medical data. Clinical surveillance facilitates proactive
care by sending precise notifications to the healthcare team.

### Explore our solutions:

[Capsule Surveillance][99]

Philips IntelliSpace Critical Care and Anesthesia (ICCA) is a clinical decision support and
documentation solution for the complex critical and perioperative care environments. ICCA
centralizes, streamlines and provides simplified visual data to deliver structured documentation and
support high-quality and efficient care delivery.

The Design Award.
[Home][12] > Welcome

A' Design Award and Competition is one of the World’s [largest][13], [most prestigious][14] and
[influential][15] design accolades, one of the highest achievements in design. A' Design Award
Winner Logo, symbolizes exceptional design excellence in your products, projects and services.

Enter Your Work

A' Design Award, recognizing the excellent and original design work from across the globe, is one of
the highest achievements in design, a source of inspiration for award-winning designers, artists,
architects, brands and design agencies. Entry and nomination is open to all from all countries.

[A' Design Award Registration][16]
Winners' Showcase

A' Design Award presents you with the World’s best design work at the A' Design Award Winners'
Designs Showcase. Enjoy a fine selection, the crème de la crème, if you will, in arts, architecture,
fashion, communication and product design. Discover great designers and brands whose superior design
products, projects and services inspire and advance our society.

[Design Award Winners' Showcase][17]
Gala Night

La Notte Premio A', the Gala-Night and Award Ceremony of the A' Design Award and Competition is
widely regarded as one of the most exclusive social events in design industry, and is considered to
be the design industry's premier annual red-carpet event. The A' Design Award Gala is attended by
personalities from the arts, fashion, high-society, film, architecture, industry and design media.

[La Notte Prelimo A]
Gala Night : **[La Notte Premio A'][18]**

[Design Award Ceremony]
[Design Award Winners Ceremony]
[Design Award Ceremony and Gala]
Entry Deadline

A' Design Award and Competition has multiple entry periods. You should nominate your design before
the counter reaches zero to benefit from complimentary preliminary checks.

[A' Design Award Timeline][19]
Award Jury

A' Design Award Grand Jury Panel brings together the World’s leading design professionals, prominent
academics, influential press members and leading experts in industry to recognize, cherish and value
good design products, projects and services. A' Design Award jurors are fully committed to
acknowledge and distinguish good design in all its forms.

[Design Award Jury][20]
Got Good Design?

Do you know how good your design is? Is your design ready to take part in the competition or maybe
it is not yet ready? How could you improve your design presentation to affect press members, design
buyers and design lovers? A' Design Awards offers you a free of charge, obligation-free,
confidential service called “Preliminary Checks” allowing you to get a Design Score and learn how
good your design is, and how to improve its presentation.

[Free Design Score][21]
Exhibition

A' Design Award Exhibition, organized shortly after results announcement at MOOD Design Museum in
Italy, and later moved to several countries and cities, marks the grand opening of a new edition of
the annual design competition. The design exhibition provides an opportunity for architects,
designers and businesses to showcase their latest products, projects and services, setting the
design trends for the year.

and publicity services in addition to the award trophy, certificate, yearbook and of course the
winner logo which laureates could use to differentiate and add further value their award-winning
products, projects and services.

[Design Prize][23]
Award Categories

Any artifact, creation, art work, product, project or service that involves good design, enhanced
aesthetics, creative ideation, design thinking, superior engineering, and/or original innovation
could be nominated for A' Design Award. Entries are accepted for stand-alone works as well as
collections and product families. There are also very special design award categories for
recognizing lifelong achievements of brands, design agencies and individuals.

[Design Award Categories][24]
Trophy

Omega Particle, the A' Design Award Trophy, designed in Italy, is a tangible and durable reminder of
design excellence achievement, and serves as recognition and evidence of merit for good design. The
A' Design Award Trophy, granted to eligible laureates, is coveted by designers, artists and
architects worldwide.

[Design Award Trophy]
Omega Particle : **[A' Design Award Trophy][25]**
[Trophy of Design Awards]
[Design Trophy]
[Design Award Trophies]
[Design Trophy Packaging]
Press Room

A' Design Award's Press Room grants prominent press members and leading journalists access to high
resolution images and electronic press kits of the World’s best art works, products, designs and
architecture. Accredited editors will also be able to access profile and portrait images of
award-winning designers, logos of award-winning brands as well as exclusive interviews with
designers regarding their design philosophy and their award-winning works.

[Design Award Press Room][26]
Mission, Vision & Action

A' Design Award and Competition was established to create a global appreciation and awareness for
good design as well as to promote good design practices and principles worldwide. The ultimate aim
of the design accolade is to make the World a better place by promoting, publishing and advertising
good designs in all industries. A' Design Award incentivizes designers, agencies and companies
worldwide to come up with superior products, projects and services that benefit society by annually
recognizing, awarding and celebrating the very best design work from across the globe, consequently
channeling attention of press members, design media, design oriented audiences, distributors and
buyers to award-winning works.

[Design Award Press Room][27]
Get Involved

Connect, network and reach out to the World’s leading designers, artists, architects and
design-oriented brands and institutions by getting involved with A’ Design Award. There are many
ways to connect and collaborate, including but not limited to design award sponsorship, good design
patronage, jury membership and good design activism.

[Get Involved With A' Design Award][28]
Winners’ Kit

A' Design Award winner kit includes everything laureates need for promoting, publicizing and
advertising their award-winning products, projects and services. Winners’ Kit includes the design
award logo, yearbook inclusion, certificate, trophy, gala invitation, exhibition space, design
rankings inclusion, business networking opportunities, promotion and public relations services for
the award-winning design.

[Design Award Winners Kit]

[Design Award Bag]

A' Design Award & Competition is pleased to provide you with all the support you need for taking
part in the accolade, starting with clear guidelines on how you should prepare your nomination;
standardized presentations are required to ensure all entries are voted on equal grounds. Learn how
to benefit from complimentary preliminary score and presentation improvement services, made
available to all participants without any fees.

[Get Support][30]

Billions of Impressions, Tens of Millions of Pageviews, Tens of Thousands of Registrations, Tens of
Thousands of Project Submissions, Thousands of Eliminated Projects, Thousands of Award Winners,
Hundreds of Judges, 110+ Categories, 40+ Languages, 17 Years..

[See Big Numbers][31]
Summary

TL;DR : One of the World’s largest design accolades recognizing and promoting good design. Highest
achievement in design, extremely prestigious thanks to grand award jury, blind peer-review process,
ethical evaluation methodology and the design prize. Entries open right now for brands and
individuals.

[Register and Enter Work][32]
Learn More

A' Design Award and Competition has thousands of pages providing in-depth notes, clarifications and
documentation for participating in the design competition, about the design prize and the accolade
in general. Enter the A' Design Award knowledge base and information portal to find everything you
could potentially need to know about the design award before, during or after taking part. Access
frequently asked questions, award methodology, voting mechanism, presentation guidelines and other
content detailing each and every step of design award participation, evaluation and celebration.

[Design Award Information][33]
Featured Competition

The **Future Kitchen Design Awards**, presented by **BOTINKIT** in collaboration with the **A'
Design Award**, invites visionary designers worldwide to reimagine cooking and kitchen spaces
through groundbreaking technology and intelligent design. This prestigious competition seeks
innovative solutions that fuse artificial intelligence, robotics, and human-centric functionality,
transforming traditional culinary methods into seamless digital experiences. Participants have the
opportunity to showcase their creativity across diverse categories, including product design,
architecture, digital interfaces, and innovative service models, with the chance to win cash prizes,
international recognition, exhibition opportunities, and potential internships, all aligning with
BOTINKIT’s mission of shaping the kitchens of tomorrow.

The Design Award.
[Home][12] > Welcome

A' Design Award and Competition is one of the World’s [largest][13], [most prestigious][14] and
[influential][15] design accolades, one of the highest achievements in design. A' Design Award
Winner Logo, symbolizes exceptional design excellence in your products, projects and services.

Enter Your Work

A' Design Award, recognizing the excellent and original design work from across the globe, is one of
the highest achievements in design, a source of inspiration for award-winning designers, artists,
architects, brands and design agencies. Entry and nomination is open to all from all countries.

[A' Design Award Registration][16]
Winners' Showcase

A' Design Award presents you with the World’s best design work at the A' Design Award Winners'
Designs Showcase. Enjoy a fine selection, the crème de la crème, if you will, in arts, architecture,
fashion, communication and product design. Discover great designers and brands whose superior design
products, projects and services inspire and advance our society.

[Design Award Winners' Showcase][17]
Gala Night

La Notte Premio A', the Gala-Night and Award Ceremony of the A' Design Award and Competition is
widely regarded as one of the most exclusive social events in design industry, and is considered to
be the design industry's premier annual red-carpet event. The A' Design Award Gala is attended by
personalities from the arts, fashion, high-society, film, architecture, industry and design media.

Entry Deadline

A' Design Award and Competition has multiple entry periods. You should nominate your design before
the counter reaches zero to benefit from complimentary preliminary checks.

[A' Design Award Timeline][19]
Award Jury

A' Design Award Grand Jury Panel brings together the World’s leading design professionals, prominent
academics, influential press members and leading experts in industry to recognize, cherish and value
good design products, projects and services. A' Design Award jurors are fully committed to
acknowledge and distinguish good design in all its forms.

[Design Award Jury][20]
Got Good Design?

Do you know how good your design is? Is your design ready to take part in the competition or maybe
it is not yet ready? How could you improve your design presentation to affect press members, design
buyers and design lovers? A' Design Awards offers you a free of charge, obligation-free,
confidential service called “Preliminary Checks” allowing you to get a Design Score and learn how
good your design is, and how to improve its presentation.

[Free Design Score][21]
Exhibition

A' Design Award Exhibition, organized shortly after results announcement at MOOD Design Museum in
Italy, and later moved to several countries and cities, marks the grand opening of a new edition of
the annual design competition. The design exhibition provides an opportunity for architects,
designers and businesses to showcase their latest products, projects and services, setting the
design trends for the year.

advertising and acknowledging good design worldwide. The A' Design Prize includes public relations
and publicity services in addition to the award trophy, certificate, yearbook and of course the
winner logo which laureates could use to differentiate and add further value their award-winning
products, projects and services.

[Design Prize][23]
Award Categories

Any artifact, creation, art work, product, project or service that involves good design, enhanced
aesthetics, creative ideation, design thinking, superior engineering, and/or original innovation
could be nominated for A' Design Award. Entries are accepted for stand-alone works as well as
collections and product families. There are also very special design award categories for
recognizing lifelong achievements of brands, design agencies and individuals.

[Design Award Categories][24]
Trophy

Omega Particle, the A' Design Award Trophy, designed in Italy, is a tangible and durable reminder of
design excellence achievement, and serves as recognition and evidence of merit for good design. The
A' Design Award Trophy, granted to eligible laureates, is coveted by designers, artists and
architects worldwide.

[Design Award Trophy]

Press Room

A' Design Award's Press Room grants prominent press members and leading journalists access to high
resolution images and electronic press kits of the World’s best art works, products, designs and
architecture. Accredited editors will also be able to access profile and portrait images of
award-winning designers, logos of award-winning brands as well as exclusive interviews with
designers regarding their design philosophy and their award-winning works.

[Design Award Press Room][26]
Mission, Vision & Action

A' Design Award and Competition was established to create a global appreciation and awareness for
good design as well as to promote good design practices and principles worldwide. The ultimate aim
of the design accolade is to make the World a better place by promoting, publishing and advertising
good designs in all industries. A' Design Award incentivizes designers, agencies and companies
worldwide to come up with superior products, projects and services that benefit society by annually
recognizing, awarding and celebrating the very best design work from across the globe, consequently
channeling attention of press members, design media, design oriented audiences, distributors and
buyers to award-winning works.

[Design Award Press Room][27]
Get Involved

Connect, network and reach out to the World’s leading designers, artists, architects and
design-oriented brands and institutions by getting involved with A’ Design Award. There are many
ways to connect and collaborate, including but not limited to design award sponsorship, good design
patronage, jury membership and good design activism.

[Get Involved With A' Design Award][28]
Winners’ Kit

A' Design Award winner kit includes everything laureates need for promoting, publicizing and
advertising their award-winning products, projects and services. Winners’ Kit includes the design
award logo, yearbook inclusion, certificate, trophy, gala invitation, exhibition space, design
rankings inclusion, business networking opportunities, promotion and public relations services for
the award-winning design.

content detailing each and every step of design award participation, evaluation and celebration.

The **Future Kitchen Design Awards**, presented by **BOTINKIT** in collaboration with the **A'
Design Award**, invites visionary designers worldwide to reimagine cooking and kitchen spaces
through groundbreaking technology and intelligent design. This prestigious competition seeks
innovative solutions that fuse artificial intelligence, robotics, and human-centric functionality,
transforming traditional culinary methods into seamless digital experiences. Participants have the
opportunity to showcase their creativity across diverse categories, including product design,
architecture, digital interfaces, and innovative service models, with the chance to win cash prizes,
international recognition, exhibition opportunities, and potential internships, all aligning with
BOTINKIT’s mission of shaping the kitchens of tomorrow.

### APIs

[Find out more][139]

We understand what is at stake in your API program and bring decades of experience in development
and manufacturing to ensure a reliable, high-quality drug substance supply that keeps your project
progressing with confidence.

Our API development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* [**Peptides**][140]
* [**PepCellerate™ FIH Peptide-Injectable Clinical Trial Supply**][141]
* [**Tag-Assisted Peptide Synthesis (TAPS)**][142]
* [**Oligonucleotides**][143]
* [**HPAPIs**][144]
* [**Small Molecules**][145]
* [**API Support Services**][146] (Flow Chemistry, Crystallization, Solid Forms,
  Polymorphism, Purification Services)

### Drug Products

[Find out more][147]

Our broad spectrum of drug product capabilities spans from clinical development through
commercialization across a wide range of dosage forms, including Oral Solid Dosage
(OSD), Aseptic Fill and Finish sterile injectables, and Oral Peptide Delivery, covering multiple
modalities, including highly potent compounds. With advanced packaging, labeling, and serialization
capabilities, we deliver reliable, high-quality drug product supply to support your program at every
stage. 

Our Drug Product development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* **Non-Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * [**Oral Solid Dose**][148]
  * [**Non-Sterile Liquids**][149]
  * [**Rectal Dosage Forms**][150]
* **Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * **[Aseptic Fill & Finish][151]  **
  * [**Sterile Liquids**][152]
  * [**Sterile Powder-Lyophilized Vials**][153]
* [**Drug Product Specialities**][154]
  * [**Bioavailability Enhancement**][155]
  * [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][156]
  * [**Oral Peptide Delivery**][157]
* **Packaging**
  * [**Pharma Packaging Services**][158]

### Lipid Excipients & Nanomedicines

[Find out more][159]

We are a global CDMO leader in pioneering specialized lipid-based products, supporting the
development and manufacturing of nanomedicines with expertise in synthetic lipid process
development, LNP formulation, scale-up, and large-scale manufacturing. Our high-quality lipid
excipient building blocks, LNP starter kits, and cutting-edge technologies support your supply of
lipid-based medicines, no matter the scale or phase of development. 

Our Lipid Excipient and Nanomedicine capabilities include:
* [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][160]
* [**LNP Starter Kits**][161]
* [**Custom Lipid Manufacturing**][162]
* [**Standard Lipids Catalog**][163]
* **[Lipid Excipient Technologies][164] **(ADME & DMPK, SORT-Coated LNPs)

### True End-to-End Supply

Managing multiple CDMOs across development stages and technologies increases coordination effort,
risk, and timelines. CordenPharma integrates development and manufacturing of complex modalities
across APIs, Drug Products and Packaging at all scales, coordinated through a global delivery and
project management model.

**What this means for you: **
* Fewer handovers between suppliers and project phases
* Clear accountability across development and manufacturing activities
* Better visibility and control from early development through commercial supply

Our approach to every project begins with fostering a constant exchange between the applicable API,

Data Insights Market is one of the leading providers of syndicated and customized research reports,
consulting services, and analytical information on markets and companies across the world. Data
Insights Market partners with clients in many countries and industry verticals such as A & D,
Chemical & material, Energy Power, F & B, Retail, Healthcare and many more to provide high value
market research reports and consulting services. Our skilled analysts work towards understanding the
specific needs of each client to produce relevant insights that most suit his individual needs.
Since its inception, Data Insights Market has continued to innovate, increased its product and
service portfolio, and remained focused on the needs of its clients to root out poor-quality data
and establish itself as a winning partner for businesses. DIM has a legacy of serving and

and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

monitoring system that fits securely into your hospital’s network to give you all-time data access

converts reliable measurement data - gas concentration, temperature, humidity and pressure - from
the X-node device into valuable information that you can access, analyse, visualise, monitor and
store online via the X-node Hub.

restriction to movement: The Dräger X-plore 8300 is the smallest and lightest PAPR device in its

# Welcome to The Electronic Components Industry Association (ECIA)!

ECIA is made up of the leading electronic component manufacturers, their manufacturer
representatives and authorized distributors. ECIA members share a common goal of promoting and
improving the business environment for the authorized sale of electronic components.

[ Learn More ][45]
[ person with a plus icon ][46]

### [Become a Member][47]

We are the voice of the industry.
ECIA is the only association representing all the key constituents of the electronic components
industry and your opportunity to:

### Connect. Influence. Optimize.

Whether you are a manufacturer, distributor or manufacturer's representative, we all face similar
challenges in business. ECIA serves as the platform to influence policies that directly impact the
efficiency of the supply chain and the future of electronics.

[ Join Today ][48]
[ lock icon ][49]

### [Members Only][50]

Members, [check here][51] for quick links members only information.

[Texas A&M Study: Value of the Authorized Channel][52]

[ECIA Member Marketing Materials][53]

[Stats and Insights][54]

[Popular Documents][55]

[ECIA PACE Training][56]

[Webinars][57]

[ Read More ][58]
[ handshake icon ][59]

### [2026 Executive Conference][60]

#### Save the Date - October 19 - 21

##### **Who Attends the Conference?**

75 % of attendees are directors, vice presidents, presidents and c-suite executives from over 200
leading industry companies! The conference is the PREMIER event for industry executives.

##### **What to Expect at the Conference**

From hosted receptions to networking breaks, the conference provides ample time to connect with old
friends and make new acquaintances. An event mobile app connects participants and speakers while
delivering presentation materials.

[ Read More ][61]
[ book icon ][62]

### [PACE Training][63]

ECIA member companies and their employees have access to these unique training courses as a
members-only benefit. ECIA Foundation’s PACE (Paul Andrews Continuous Education) training is for
ECIA members and sponsor companies only. The training explains key concepts in the electronics
industry. With over 2,000 learners, the PACE program equips new employees with essential industry
knowledge through [20 comprehensive courses][64] ... and more on the way!

[ Access PACE Courses ][65]

# Welcome to The Electronic Components Industry Association (ECIA)!

ECIA is made up of the leading electronic component manufacturers, their manufacturer
representatives and authorized distributors. ECIA members share a common goal of promoting and
improving the business environment for the authorized sale of electronic components.

[ Learn More ][45]

We are the voice of the industry.
ECIA is the only association representing all the key constituents of the electronic components
industry and your opportunity to:

Whether you are a manufacturer, distributor or manufacturer's representative, we all face similar
challenges in business. ECIA serves as the platform to influence policies that directly impact the
efficiency of the supply chain and the future of electronics.

# Full-Lifecycle Embedded Product Engineering

From silicon selection and PCB design to firmware, embedded Linux, edge AI, and cloud — we engineer
your product end to end.

[Start Your Project][244]

## ABOUT US

[

### 16+ Years of Excellence


In field for over 16 years, we have carved out ourselves a niche position in the industry helping
customers with our innovative solutions and dedicated services across domain verticals.

][245][

### Dedicated Team


Embien is what our team is. A family of energetic and dedicated professionals across 3 development
centers, driven by the company's vision of empowering the world with technological innovation.

][246][

### Capable Leadership


Our company is led by industry veterans of 24+ years with proven experience in heading large
development centers/BUs. Hands-on engineers themselves with passion for customer satisfaction.

][247]

## Why Embien?

Embien, with its rich technological expertise and unique engagement models, has been a trusted
partner in many of our customer success stories. Some of our credentials are

[Time Icon]

Years of experience in embedded product engineering across all major application domains.

[Smile Icon]

Happy Clients that we have served so far since inception.

[Product Icon]

Products we engineered running in the field for many thousands of years cumulatively.

[Solution Icon]

IPs and Solutions that we have developed in house to accelerate product development.

## Services

Embien is a leading services organization that is trusted by enterprises, OEM's, Tier 1's and
startups alike across geographies to travel together in their business transformation process. Our
services offerings are:

[[Product Engineering Icon]

#### Product Engineering

One stop service provider for all your electronic product, embedded software, and electro-mechanical
developments.

][248]
[[Cloud and App Development Icon]

#### Cloud and App Development

Enterprise grade full cycle cloud computing platform development services and native/hybrid mobile
app development.

][249]
[[Cyber Security Icon]

#### Cyber Security

Comprehensive services to protect your digital assets with specialized focus on embedded device and
data security.

][250]
[[Data and Analytics Icon]

#### Data and Analytics

Leverage the power of our IoT and AI/ML development services to acquire data and gain actionable
business insights.

][251]
[[Quality Assurance Icon]

#### Quality Assurance

Whether it is a software product or an embedded electronic product, validate them and protect your
brand reputation.

][252]
[[Technology Consulting Icon]

#### Technology Consulting

Consult our expert team with deep domain and technology expertise to navigate complex issues and
improve performance.

][253]

**International Journal of Engineering Research & Technology** is a **peer-reviewed, open access**
and **multidisciplinary engineering, technology and science journal** that publishes original
research & review articles of all major branches of Engineering, Science and Technology. We have
adopted a fully open access publishing model which allows open global access to its published
content so anyone can download & read articles round the clock totally free of cost. IJERT is
included in many leading abstracting and indexing open access databases like Google Scholar &
ResearchGate. For a complete list, [view here.][42]

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is practice management software?

Practice management software is a digital tool that handles the administrative side of running a
healthcare practice: appointment scheduling, patient records, billing and reporting. It automates
routine tasks so your team spends time on patients, not paperwork.

How much does Medesk cost?

Medesk has a permanently free plan for up to 2 users, 1,000 patient records and 50 appointments per
month. The Pro plan starts at $16 per month per 50 appointments, with unlimited users and patient
records, and comes with a 7-day free trial. No credit card required.

Is Medesk secure and GDPR-compliant?

Yes. Data is encrypted in transfer and in storage, backups run automatically, and role-based access
rights control what each team member sees. Medesk is built for GDPR-compliant private practice.

Can I run video consultations with Medesk?

Yes. Telemedicine is built into the platform: turn any appointment into a video consultation with
one click, with no time limits, and run group sessions with up to 20 participants.

How long does it take to get started?

You can be ready to book patients in about 10 minutes: create your schedule, add services and share
your online booking link. Our team helps with setup and data transfer during free onboarding
consultations.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is practice management software?

Practice management software is a digital tool that handles the administrative side of running a
healthcare practice: appointment scheduling, patient records, billing and reporting. It automates
routine tasks so your team spends time on patients, not paperwork.

How much does Medesk cost?

Medesk has a permanently free plan for up to 2 users, 1,000 patient records and 50 appointments per
month. The Pro plan starts at $16 per month per 50 appointments, with unlimited users and patient
records, and comes with a 7-day free trial. No credit card required.

Is Medesk secure and GDPR-compliant?

Yes. Data is encrypted in transfer and in storage, backups run automatically, and role-based access
rights control what each team member sees. Medesk is built for GDPR-compliant private practice.

Can I run video consultations with Medesk?

Yes. Telemedicine is built into the platform: turn any appointment into a video consultation with
one click, with no time limits, and run group sessions with up to 20 participants.

How long does it take to get started?

You can be ready to book patients in about 10 minutes: create your schedule, add services and share
your online booking link. Our team helps with setup and data transfer during free onboarding
consultations.

## Why Choose Cleveland Clinic?

[patient centered care icon]

### Patient-centered care:

We don’t just care for your health conditions. We care about you. That means [our providers][65]
take the time to listen to what’s important to you before recommending next steps.

[national recognition icon]

### National recognition:

Cleveland Clinic is recognized in the U.S. and throughout the world for its expertise and care.

[skilled and collaborative providers icon]

### Collaborative providers:

You’ll get care from board-certified and fellowship trained experts who work together to create a
treatment plan just for you. Only the highest standards ensure [excellent outcomes][66].

[Innovation and Research Icon]

### Innovation and research:

We’re focused on today — and tomorrow. Our focus on [research][67] and offering the latest options
means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find
elsewhere.

## For Providers

Explore a curated collection of helpful resources and tools for medical professionals

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care
and drive better outcomes.

### Join Our Nursing Team

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

### ConsultQD

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

### Education

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

### Research

We’re committed to improving care and finding tomorrow’s cures. Learn about our [cutting-edge basic,
translational and clinical research][97].

View our [full list of resources][98] for medical professionals, including our Alumni Association,
DrConnect, and MyPractice.

## About Us

Advanced medical equipment plays a crucial role in enhancing the quality of life and fulfilling
people's unwavering pursuit of good health. With the belief that "the world is flat" and "a healthy
world is accessible," the founders of Minttihealth have joined hands with the aim of leveraging
modern technologies to create a better and healthier world.

Minttihealth takes pride in its exceptional team, which mainly consists of scientists from the
Chinese Academy of Sciences, who are leaders in their respective fields such as sensors, acoustic
signal processing, electro-physiological signal processing, intelligent network platform
construction, and algorithms. Some of our team members come from the design and manufacturing
industries of intelligent electronic products, with the ability to transform blueprints into
reality. Others are from top medical equipment companies worldwide, who possess a profound insight
into the global medical market.

Minttihealth has a valuable resource of expert clinical medical professionals, who act as the
primary data entry for our telemedicine system. With their extensive clinical experience combined
with vast amounts of user data, we can efficiently test and upgrade algorithm calibration and
inspection.

At Minttihealth, we continuously strive to discover novel ways and means for healthcare and disease
prevention. Starting with the hardware/software technology of the medical Internet of Things, we are
committed to optimizing disease management and auxiliary diagnosis and treatment practices. Our
primary focus is on the application of medical and health big data analysis and intelligence (AI),
ensuring that everyone has access to advanced and efficient medical care health network.

Advanced medical equipment plays a crucial role in enhancing the quality of life and fulfilling
people's unwavering pursuit of good health. With the belief that "the world is flat" and "a healthy
world is accessible," the founders of Minttihealth have joined hands with the aim of leveraging
modern technologies to create a better and healthier world.
